transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

Well, I came in because my sleep is just... it's all broken up lately. I work overnight shifts as a personal care aide, and when I get off work, I just lie there wide awake. And then, when I finally do manage to drift off, I wake up feeling really scared. It's like I never even rested at all.
When you wake up feeling scared, do you remember having nightmares or vivid dreams?

No, not really. I don't remember any dreams or nightmares. I just... wake up, and my heart is pounding, and I feel this awful dread. But there's no dream that goes with it, at least not that I can remember.
When you wake up with your heart pounding and feeling dread, does it happen suddenly during the night, like you're jolted awake, or does it happen more gradually as you're waking up?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. It's kind of hard to tell. I just... I open my eyes and I'm already awake, and that dread is just sitting there on me. I haven't really noticed if I'm jolted awake or if it happens slower. I just know I'm awake and my heart is already going fast.
Has your heart ever started pounding while you're still asleep, or does it only start when you're already waking up?
I don't really know. Like I said, I'm just asleep and then I'm awake, and my heart is already pounding. I can't really tell what it's doing before I open my eyes.
Have you ever woken up in the middle of the night with a sudden rush of fear or panic that seems to come out of nowhere?

No, I don't think so. I mean, it's just like what I was saying... I just wake up and the dread is there. It's not like a sudden panic attack or anything that wakes me up out of nowhere. It's just... I wake up, and I feel awful. That's really all it is.
Do you ever experience sudden episodes during the day where your heart starts racing, you feel very anxious, or you have a sense that something terrible is going to happen?

No, not really. During the day, I just feel... heavy and sad all the time. But I don't get those sudden rushes of panic or my heart racing out of nowhere. It's just a constant, low feeling, not a sudden attack like that.
Have you ever woken up and found that you couldn't move your body right away, like you were temporarily paralyzed, even though you were awake?
No, I've never had that happen. When I wake up, I can move fine... I just usually don't want to. But I'm not paralyzed or anything like that.
After you wake up feeling that dread, do you have a hard time falling back asleep, or do you usually stay awake?

I usually stay awake. My sleep is just all broken up right now. I'll get off an overnight shift and just lie in bed wide awake. Then when I do finally drift off, I wake up scared with that dread... and I can't get back to sleep. I just feel like I never rested at all.
Have you ever woken up and been unable to move your body for a short time, even though you were awake?

I think you just asked me that a minute ago... but no. Like I said, I've never been paralyzed or anything. When I wake up, I can move my body just fine. I just usually don't have the energy to actually get up.
Have you ever woken up and been unable to move your body for a short time, even though you were awake?
You... you're asking me that again. Um, no. Like I told you the last two times, I've never had that happen. I can move just fine when I wake up, I just don't want to.
Have you been feeling a lack of energy or a lot of fatigue nearly every day?
Yeah. Like I was just saying a second ago, I really don't have the energy to do much of anything. It's pretty much every day right now. I just feel completely drained.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, or do you no longer take pleasure in them?

I don't think so. I mean, I haven't really noticed that. I still like the same things I always did. It's just... like I was saying, I'm way too tired to actually go out and do any of them right now. But I haven't lost interest.

Has there ever been a time when you were sleeping and suddenly woke up with an intense feeling of fear or panic that seemed to come out of nowhere, like something startled you awake even though you couldn’t remember a dream?
No, I haven't had that happen. I mean, I wake up tired and everything, but I don't wake up panicked or scared like that.
Do you ever feel excessively sleepy during the day, even if you’ve had some sleep?

No, not really sleepy. I mean, I'm exhausted, like I said, but it's not like I'm falling asleep in the middle of the day. I just feel heavy and don't have the energy to do anything, but I'm not nodding off or anything like that.
When you get into bed after your overnight shift, how long does it usually take you to fall asleep?

Well, that's actually why I came in. My sleep is just all broken up lately. I get off my overnight shift, and I'll just lie there wide awake for a long time. I don't know exactly how long, but it takes forever. And then when I do finally drift off, I wake up feeling scared, and I just feel like I never rested at all.
Would you say you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, I do. Most days I just feel... heavy and empty from the minute I open my eyes. It's like the person I used to be, the one who went to church, did Zumba, and helped the kids at the center... she's just gone.
When you wake up in the morning after trying to sleep, does your mood or energy level get worse right after you wake up, or does it stay about the same throughout the day?

I haven't really noticed it getting worse at any specific time. It... it just stays about the same, honestly. I wake up feeling that heavy way, and it pretty much just lasts the whole day. I don't think it really changes.
Have you noticed that activities you used to enjoy don't bring you the same pleasure anymore, even if you still try to do them?
I'm not really sure. I haven't even tried to go to Zumba or do any of those things lately... so I don't really know if I would enjoy them or not if I tried. I just haven't been doing them at all.
